description.value: A tidy private campground on Sechelt Inlet Road in Sechelt, two minutes from Porpoise Bay Provincial Park, with treed tent sites, coin showers, flush toilets, and easy access to Sechelt Inlet paddling and Coast Gravity Park's downhill trails; requires a ferry crossing from the mainland and charges nightly fees.

address.value: 6040 Sechelt Inlet Road, Sechelt, BC V0N 3A3

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active campground on the Sunshine Coast near Sechelt, open year-round, with tent sites, partial hookup, and full hookup RV sites. Showers are confirmed via 'Wash House with coin-operated showers and flush toilets' on the RV Sites page. Food nearby is confirmed by mention of being less than 5 minutes from Sechelt Village with 'many eateries nearby.' Reservations are confirmed by the detailed booking/deposit policy on the Reserve page. The site notably has a bike wash station mentioned on the front page. OSM name contains a typo ('Campgroud') and reversed word order ('RV & Park' vs '& RV Park'). OSM lacks phone and address, which the website provides.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, year-round campground on the Sunshine Coast with tent sites, showers, and a bike wash station — a clear fit for touring cyclists traveling the ferry route from Vancouver.
